reviewed_records.label: Horizontal Selector
reviewed_records.depicts: A horizontal selector or handle used to adjust or highlight a left-to-right control.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a horizontal selector, drag handle, or horizontal adjustment point.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface adjusts, highlights, or exposes a selector that moves along a horizontal axis.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for plain divider lines or left-right navigation when the meaning is specifically a horizontal selector or adjustment handle.

reviewed_records.label: Vertical Selector
reviewed_records.depicts: A vertical selector or handle used to adjust or highlight an up-and-down control.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a vertical selector, drag handle, or vertical adjustment point.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface adjusts, highlights, or exposes a selector that moves along a vertical axis.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for plain divider lines or up-down navigation when the meaning is specifically a vertical selector or adjustment handle.
